_adapt.purpose: External project adaptation guide (ops.mjs only reads data keys from this file — _adapt is guide-only, not referenced by code).
_adapt.how: Set base_branch to the target repository's default branch name (main/master, etc.). github_account is an optional field required only when multiple GitHub accounts are logged in via gh CLI on a single machine (used for multi-account disambiguation via `gh auth token -u <account>`). Omit for single-account environments — when omitted, gh CLI defaults to the active login account. If needed, add "github_account": "<account_name>" directly to this file.
